title: Case study: a splicing kinase inhibitor in nanopore long reads
text: CLK genes among : lorecivivint raises one protein coding isoform CLK1, CLK3 CLK4.  gene-level results show classification needs care. CLK1 CLK3 significant DESeq2, shrunken fold changes (1.8-fold) 2-fold cutoff. reason isoform_switches() count changed genes: isoforms CLK1 explain gene-level change. CLK1-201 encodes full-length kinase. CLK1-204 transcript without exon 4, shifts reading frame makes target nonsense-mediated decay. CLK1-210 keeps introns sides exon 4. CLK1 activity favours skipping exon 4, CLK inhibitors shift balance towards full-length isoform (Uzor et al. 2018). long reads show shift. full-length isoform rises 19 52 transcripts per million. skipped one falls 4 1.5 (significant , q = 0.36).
code: plot_log2fc(iso, feature = c("CLK1", "CLK3", "CLK4"), ncol = 2) deg |>   left_join(annot_data_genes(iso)[c("gene_id", "gene_name")], by = "gene_id") |>   filter(gene_name %in% c("CLK1", "CLK3", "CLK4")) |>   select(gene_name, log2FC, qvalue, deg_sig) #> # A tibble: 3 × 4 #>   gene_name log2FC      qvalue deg_sig #>   <chr>      <dbl>       <dbl> <chr>   #> 1 CLK1       0.881 0.000000176 no      #> 2 CLK3       0.827 0.000142    no      #> 3 CLK4       0.696 0.0616      no plot_tx_expr(iso, gene_name = "CLK1", group = "condition") plot_genomic_context(iso, gene_name = "CLK1")

title: Transcriptomic diversity
text: tx_diversity() summarises gene uses isoforms: many annotated, assayed expressed, many transcript types span, isoform dominates effective number isoforms (1 single isoform carries expression, equal number isoforms expressed evenly).

title: Functional enrichment by transcript type
text: run_enrichment() expands gene sets transcripts genes runs gene set enrichment analysis (fgsea) separately protein coding transcripts unproductive categories (retained intron, nonsense-mediated decay transcripts without defined coding sequence), combined individually. result can stored object saved . plot_enrichment() draws pathways side side transcript category.

title: Functional enrichment by transcript type
text: default transcripts ranked log2 fold-change, point estimate ignores well determined. rank_by = "signed_p" ranks -log10(pvalue) sign fold-change, test differential expression weighs ranking. rank_by = "lfc_z" ranks median fold-change inferential replicates divided standard deviation, fold-change quantification determine ranks low; needs fold-change table add_uncertainty(x, group = ) stores (see uncertainty article), object . rank_by column result records choice.
code: set.seed(42) enrichment_p <- run_enrichment(iso, genesets, pval_cutoff = 0.05, rank_by = "signed_p") table(enrichment_p$experiment) #>  #>        nonsense_mediated_decay                 protein_coding  #>                            123                            247  #> protein_coding_CDS_not_defined                retained_intron  #>                             57                            147  #>                   unproductive  #>                            224

text: genesets_list can also named list collections, example list(hallmark = read_gmt(h), reactome = read_gmt(r)). collection tested , adjusted p-values collection; result collection column plot_enrichment() draws one panel per collection. title: Introduction to isoformic
text: isoformic interprets RNA-seq data level annotated transcripts. Instead asking whether gene changes conditions, asks isoforms change, type transcript (protein coding, retained intron, nonsense-mediated decay, …) expression gene distributed across . Everything revolves around IsoformicExperiment object. holds, samples, transcript-level assays, gene-level assays derived , exon structures every annotated transcript differential expression results, backed Parquet files disk. article builds object quantification differential expression tables shows look . analyses one article : Transcriptomic diversity: many isoforms gene uses, one dominates isoform switches happen. Quantification uncertainty: well reads determine isoform, isoforms told apart stable direction differential expression call replicates. makes isoform hard quantify?: isoforms reads leave uncertain, , far 30 Gibbs draws can trusted measure . Isoform structure productivity: open reading frames, nonsense-mediated decay, productive fractions, poison exons external evidence. Alternative polyadenylation: 3’ end usage, 3’ UTR length gene set enrichment change. Functional enrichment transcript type: gene set enrichment run separately coding unproductive transcripts, choice ranking statistic gene set collections. Plots: fold-change, expression profile genomic context plots. annotations: T2T-CHM13, Ensembl, RefSeq, haplotype-resolved assemblies, FANTOM CAT long-read catalogs. Working plain tables: table-based counterparts every step. start Salmon output instead ready-made tables, see Salmon quantifications IsoformicExperiment. Two case studies apply workflow complete public datasets: chronic stress mouse brain (short reads, Salmon) splicing kinase inhibitor nanopore long reads (Oarfish). examples use placenta RNA-seq dataset “Landscape Dysregulated Placental RNA Editing Associated Preeclampsia”: 8 preeclamptic 17 control placentas quantified Salmon (Patro et al. 2017) GENCODE v50 tested differential expression swish (Zhu et al. 2019) 30 Gibbs draws, transcript level gene level (counts draws summed isoforms gene). tables Parquet files source repository package, vignettes/articles/data/preeclampsia/: large install package, code reads directory, relative article. abundance table holds TPM 126,670 transcripts tested swish, ones transcript-level results; transcripts gene come annotation. isoformic relies transcript types GENCODE annotation. annotation must one used quantification, GENCODE v50. download_reference() fetches package cache (step needs internet connection first time) prepare_isoformic_annotation() converts GFF3 file, , directory Parquet tables. tables can inspected read_parquet(), normally object reads . cache location every setting package reads documented ?isoformic-options. transcript-level abundance table (TPM) sample metadata needed. Transcript IDs checked annotation, sample IDs metadata. object behaves like SummarizedExperiment: Gene-level assays derived demand summing isoforms gene cached. Results tool can attached: column names log2FoldChange, padj, logFC FDR standardised log2FC, pvalue qvalue, IDs validated annotation. Significance flagged stored cutoffs (absolute log2 fold-change 1 adjusted p-value 0.05 default). de_table() combines levels one long table, one row per feature, plots consume. fold-change plot compares change gene transcripts, coloured transcript type; plots article covers others.  whole object, including results, written directory Parquet files restored read_isoformic(). title: From Salmon quantifications to an IsoformicExperiment
text: recommend Salmon (Patro et al. 2017) selective-alignment mode GENCODE transcriptome, inferential replicates swish (Zhu et al. 2019) can used transcript-level differential expression. Salmon 2 -scratch rewrite Rust (2.8.0 time writing). workflow (salmon index, salmon quant, quant.sf) output files , read_salmon(), tximeta, tximport swish work unchanged, index format new: index built Salmon 1.x rejected must rebuilt (last C++ release, 1.12.0, remains available salmon-cpp conda package). changes worth knowing: selective alignment mapping mode (--validateMappings -op), quantification deterministic default (identical output thread count), decoy sequences longer appear quant.sf, --ignoreTxVersion matches transcript identifiers without version suffix gene map given. Salmon migration guide lists every removed ignored option. typical single-sample invocation shell : --libType detects library type, index built GENCODE transcript FASTA salmon index --gencode (truncates transcript names first |), --posBias --seqBias --gcBias correct biases, --dumpEq --dumpEqWeights keep equivalence classes --numGibbsSamples writes inferential replicates swish needs aux_info/bootstrap/. can driven R condathis package, installs Salmon Bioconda conda environment (Linux macOS, WSL2 Windows). salmon_index() salmon_quant() run commands ; first call creates environment Salmon 2.8.0: salmon_quant() draws 30 Gibbs samples per sample default (num_gibbs = 0 skips ). Besides swish, quantify well reads determine isoform, isoforms told apart stable direction differential expression call replicates; read_salmon(inferential = TRUE) reads uncertainty article explains use report . decoy-aware index (recommended Salmon authors), pass genome FASTA decoy_fasta, GENCODE GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz release: salmon_index() writes gentrome FASTA (transcripts followed genome) decoys.txt (genome sequence names) temporary directory, runs salmon index --decoys decoys.txt removes . genome makes index much larger slower build, needs free disk space tempdir() copy genome runs.
code: salmon index \   --transcripts gencode.v50.transcripts.fa.gz \   --index salmon_index \   --gencode \   --threads 8  salmon quant \   --libType A \   --index salmon_index \   --mates1 /path/SRR..._1.fastq.gz \   --mates2 /path/SRR..._2.fastq.gz \   --output /path/SRR..._quant \   --threads 8 \   --allowDovetail --softclipOverhangs \   --dumpEq --dumpEqWeights \   --posBias --seqBias --gcBias \   --numGibbsSamples 30 library(isoformic) tx_fasta <- download_reference(version = "50", file_type = "fasta") gff_path <- download_reference(version = "50", file_type = "gff")  salmon_index(fasta_path = tx_fasta, index_path = "salmon_index", is_gencode = TRUE, num_threads = 8) salmon_quant(   input_r1 = "sample_1.fastq.gz",   input_r2 = "sample_2.fastq.gz",   index_path = "salmon_index",   output_dir = "quants/sample_quant",   num_threads = 8 )

text: swish needs inferential replicates, tximeta imports Salmon output (bundled quantifications carry 20 Gibbs draws separately, mini_draws.parquet, keep package small, tximeta told skip ). results attached object; tximeta objects can also converted directly as_isoformic(se_tx, annot_path = annot_dir).
code: suppressPackageStartupMessages({   library(SummarizedExperiment)   library(fishpond) })  tximeta_coldata <- data.frame(   files = fs::path(quant_dirs, "quant.sf"),   names = names(quant_dirs),   condition = col_data$condition ) se_tx <- tximeta::tximeta(   coldata = tximeta_coldata,   type = "salmon",   txOut = TRUE,   skipMeta = TRUE,   useHub = FALSE,   ignoreAfterBar = TRUE,   skipSeqinfo = TRUE,   dropInfReps = TRUE # the draws are not in the bundled directories ) mini_draws <- as_inferential_replicates(   read_parquet(fs::path_package("isoformic", "extdata", "mini_draws.parquet")) ) names(mini_draws) <- paste0("infRep", seq_along(mini_draws)) SummarizedExperiment::assays(se_tx) <- c(   as.list(SummarizedExperiment::assays(se_tx)),   mini_draws )  y <- fishpond::scaleInfReps(se_tx) y <- fishpond::labelKeep(y, minCount = 10, minN = 3) set.seed(20261029) # swish uses permutations y <- fishpond::swish(y, x = "condition")  swish_results <- mcols(y) |>   as.data.frame() |>   tibble::rownames_to_column("transcript_id") head(swish_results) #>        transcript_id log10mean  keep stat log2FC pvalue locfdr qvalue #> 1 ENST00000367468.10 1.0366158 FALSE   NA     NA     NA     NA     NA #> 2  ENST00000681605.1 0.7665459 FALSE   NA     NA     NA     NA     NA #> 3  ENST00000680451.1 1.0361596 FALSE   NA     NA     NA     NA     NA #> 4  ENST00000490885.6 1.0145195 FALSE   NA     NA     NA     NA     NA #> 5  ENST00000559627.1 0.8826379 FALSE   NA     NA     NA     NA     NA #> 6  ENST00000466691.1 0.3940242 FALSE   NA     NA     NA     NA     NA de_tx(iso) <- swish_results head(de_tx(iso)) #> # title: From Salmon quantifications to an IsoformicExperiment
text: as_summarized_experiment() exports gene-level assays (isoforms summed, lengths averaged abundance) DESeq2 can run .
code: se_gene <- as_summarized_experiment(iso, level = "gene") SummarizedExperiment::assay(se_gene, "counts") <- round(   SummarizedExperiment::assay(se_gene, "counts") ) se_gene$condition <- factor(se_gene$condition, levels = c("control", "preeclampsia"))  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSet(se_gene, design = ~condition) dds <- dds[rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3, ] dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE) res <- DESeq2::results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "preeclampsia", "control")) shrink_type <- if (rlang::is_installed("apeglm")) "apeglm" else "normal" res_shr <- DESeq2::lfcShrink(dds, coef = "condition_preeclampsia_vs_control", res = res, type = shrink_type, quiet = TRUE)  de_gene(iso) <- as.data.frame(res_shr) head(de_gene(iso)) #> # A tibble: 6 × 7 #>   gene_id            baseMean log2FC lfcSE   pvalue  qvalue deg_sig #>   <chr>                 <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>   <dbl> <chr>   #> 1 ENSG00000184557.6     256.   1.16  0.430 0.000601 0.00722 yes     #> 2 ENSG00000108691.11     97.1 -0.802 0.899 0.0193   0.116   no      #> 3 ENSG00000090339.11    250.   0.435 0.392 0.0806   0.242   no      #> 4 ENSG00000274233.4     106.  -0.297 0.422 0.170    0.407   no      #> 5 ENSG00000073756.13     47.2  0.257 0.509 0.0405   0.162   no      #> 6 ENSG00000115415.23    779.  -0.180 0.213 0.318    0.504   no iso #> <IsoformicExperiment> mini_placenta #>   annotation : gencode_v50_mini_subset (15 genes, 158 transcripts, 1,802 exons) #>   samples    : 6 [condition] #>   transcripts: 158 assayed from 15 genes #>   assays     : abundance, counts, length #>   gene assays: derived from transcript assays on demand #>   DE results : det (158 transcripts), deg (12 genes)

text: transcript_productivity() turns features graded call, reason: productive: complete ORF identical canonical one; altered_productive: complete ORF, NMD, different protein; unproductive: ORF, NMD predicted unproductive biotype; noncoding; uncertain: enough information (example incomplete CDS annotation). productive_fraction() share gene’s expression carried productive isoforms, per condition, change. gene whose total expression flat productive fraction falls regulated post-transcriptionally. first call uses annotation (use_sequence = FALSE). productive_fraction() argument: like transcript_productivity() default, uses transcript sequences whenever annotation directory , next section (annotation directory shared articles, may already added , pf can already come sequences).

title: Is quantification uncertainty worth checking? Genome-wide evidence

For every transcript, the inferential relative variance (InfRV; Zhu et al. 2019) was averaged over samples, and transcripts with an InfRV of at least 0.5 were called uncertain. The correlation between the replicates of isoforms of the same gene was averaged over samples, and isoform pairs with a correlation of -0.5 or lower were called ambiguous and grouped (as in mmcollapse, Turro et al. 2014, with a fixed cutoff). The log2 fold-change of each isoform was recomputed on every replicate (counts scaled to a common library size, pseudocount 5) and the share of replicates that agreed on its direction was recorded (sign agreement); a fold-change that fewer than 95% of the replicates agreed on was flagged as having an unstable direction. Only transcripts with a mean estimated count of at least 1 were assessed. The contrast was knockdown versus control in the condition variable." identifiability <- equivalence_identifiability(quant_dirs) iso <- add_uncertainty(iso, paths = quant_dirs, group = "condition", identifiability = identifiability)

Gene level: gene assays derived transcript assays summing isoforms gene (abundance-weighted means length), cached, can overridden gene_assays<-. Exon level: exon structures come annotation available annot_data_exons(), exon_table() exon_diversity(). Derived results (gene assays, row data, isoform fractions, ORFs, transcript features productivity classes) cached per object .cache environment, keyed hash inputs, therefore survive copies never go stale. title: Download Reference Annotations and Sequences — download_reference
text: Downloads annotation (GFF3/GTF) sequence (transcript genome FASTA) files main public providers: "gencode" (default): GENCODE release human (GRCh38) mouse (GRCm39), including future releases. "ensembl": Ensembl release, species division (vertebrates, plants, metazoa, fungi, protists). "ncbi": NCBI assembly accession (example GCF_009914755.1 T2T-CHM13v2.0, GCF_000001405.40 GRCh38.p14). "t2t": shorthand reference = "ncbi", accession = "GCF_009914755.1" (telomere--telomere T2T-CHM13v2.0). "mane": MANE (Matched Annotation NCBI EMBL-EBI) releases, canonical transcript per protein-coding gene, Ensembl RefSeq coordinates identifiers. "fantom": FANTOM CAT transcriptome assembly (Hon et al. 2017; GRCh37/hg19) one levels (version = "lv3_robust" default; "lv1_raw", "lv2_permissive", "lv4_stringent"), GTF . FANTOM6 analyses use lv3 robust catalog. companion ID mapping, gene information CAGE cluster tables come download_fantom_cat_tables(). Instead assuming file names, function lists release directory server picks matching file, new releases new genome patch versions (example GRCh38.p15) work without package update. Files already present output_path downloaded . request determines file name (GENCODE annotations transcript sequences, MANE explicit version, FANTOM CAT), file already output_path used without contacting server. Otherwise, directory listed (transient server error, connection) exactly one file output_path matches request, file used message. GENCODE genome must release's assembly, Ensembl region = "" annotation must chr_patch_hapl_scaff file; requests current Ensembl MANE release always need listing. file reachable URL (example T2T consortium Liftoff GFF3 files) can cached way download_reference_url(), HPRC per-haplotype annotations download_hprc_annotation().

text: version Release version. GENCODE: release number ("50", 50, "M39" / "39" mouse); NULL (default) uses "50" human "M39" mouse. Ensembl: release number ("116"); NULL uses current release. MANE: "1.5"; NULL uses current release. FANTOM: level (NULL uses "lv3_robust"). NCBI: ignored (accession identifies assembly version); T2T: NULL "2.0". reference One "gencode", "ensembl", "ncbi", "t2t", "mane", "fantom". organism "human" (default) "mouse". Ensembl sets default species (homo_sapiens / mus_musculus). file_type "gff" (default), "gtf", "fasta" (transcript sequences; Ensembl cdna.file), "ncrna_fasta" (Ensembl non-coding transcript sequences), "genome_fasta" (genome sequence; provided MANE) "polya" (GENCODE manually annotated poly() sites signals, polyAs.gff3.gz; see polya_sites()). region Annotation flavour: "" (default; reference chromosomes, patches, haplotypes scaffolds), "chr" (reference chromosomes ) "primary" (primary assembly). file_type = "genome_fasta", "primary" selects primary assembly genome values full patched / toplevel genome. Ignored NCBI, T2T, MANE FANTOM. species Ensembl species name lower snake case ("homo_sapiens", "arabidopsis_thaliana"). Defaults organism. division Ensembl division: "vertebrates" (default, main Ensembl site), "plants", "metazoa", "fungi" "protists". accession NCBI assembly accession (GCF_... GCA_...), required reference = "ncbi". mane_source Identifier space MANE files: "ensembl" (default) "refseq". output_path Directory file saved. Defaults ":cache:", package cache (see get_isoformic_cache()). timeout_limit Maximum time seconds download. Takes precedence options("timeout"). text: polya_sites() describes 3' end every assayed transcript: tes_pos, tes_group (alternative 3' ends gene, transcript_features()), tes_rank (1 = proximal 3' end along direction transcription), n_tes_groups, is_proximal, is_distal. apa_type relative canonical isoform: "same_end", "tandem_utr" (different 3' end, stop codon: 3' UTR shortening lengthening), "alternative_last_exon" (different last exon), "intronic" (3' end inside intron canonical isoform, typically composite terminal exon) ""; NA gene without canonical isoform. utr3_length (transcript_orfs() sequences available, else annotated CDS). polya_signal polya_signal_distance: poly() signal hexamer (AATAAA, ATTAAA one weaker variants) found last signal_window nt transcript sequence, distance 3' end (canonical signals sit 10-30 nt upstream); NA without sequences, hexamer lies window (common, annotated 3' ends often exact cleavage site). polya_atlas, nearest atlas site within window bp 3' end: pas_site_id, pas_class, pas_tpm, pas_distance, pas_supported. atlas frozen PolyASite 2.0 table (polya_atlas = "polyasite", see frozen_data), data frame seqid, cleavage_pos, strand (optionally site_id, site_class, tpm), GENCODE polyAs.gff3.gz file (download_reference(file_type = "polya")), read_polya_gff() reads table. apa_usage() quantifies per gene, genes least two 3' end groups: share expression ending distal-3' end (distal_fraction) abundance-weighted 3' UTR length (weighted_utr3_length), per sample per group change last first group level. test_apa() tests change distal usage two groups quasi-binomial test used test_productive_fraction(), counts. gene fewer 5 reads distal ends, pooled groups, tested (statistic p-value). run_apa_enrichment() runs gene set enrichment analysis (fgsea::fgseaMultilevel()) genes ranked change distal usage (rank_by = "delta", delta_distal_fraction apa_usage()) weighted 3' UTR length (rank_by = "utr3_length", delta_weighted_utr3_length): positive score gene set whose genes move distal 3' ends, longer 3' UTRs, last group level. also takes table apa_usage() two groups, one table serves several calls. run_enrichment(), genesets_list can hold several collections, tested . gene symbol occurs keeps largest absolute change, gene sets returned (p-value cutoff).

title: Convert a GFF3/GTF Annotation to Parquet Files — prepare_isoformic_annotation
text: Converting comprehensive human GENCODE release 50 patches haplotypes (11.6 million features, gzip-compressed GFF3 GTF) takes 30 seconds 2 GB memory four DuckDB threads; result cached repeated calls file output location return immediately. memory DuckDB may use set isoformic.duckdb_memory_limit option (see isoformic-options). parser vocabulary-agnostic annotations different providers assemblies work way: GENCODE GFF3/GTF (GRCh38, GRCm39): gene/transcript/exon features gene_id, transcript_id, gene_type, transcript_type. Ensembl Ensembl Rapid Release GFF3 (e.g. T2T-CHM13 GCA_009914755.4): ncRNA_gene, mRNA, lnc_RNA, ... features, gene:/transcript: prefixed IDs, biotype, rank. NCBI RefSeq GFF3 (e.g. GCF_009914755.1_T2T-CHM13v2.0): gene-/rna- prefixed IDs, gene_biotype, mRNA/lnc_RNA/miRNA features pseudogenes carrying exons directly. T2T consortium Liftoff CAT/Liftoff GFF3 (RefSeq GENCODE lifted CHM13) HPRC per-haplotype CAT annotations: transcript_biotype, gbkey, source_gene / source_transcript attributes, kept source_gene_id / source_transcript_id lifted annotations can mapped back GRCh38 GENCODE RefSeq identifiers. MANE GFF3/GTF CHESS GFF3 (vocabulary GENCODE/RefSeq). FANTOM CAT (FANTOM5 lv1-lv4) FANTOM6 CAT GTF: __na placeholders become NA, geneClass used gene (, transcript type, transcript) type, geneCategory, DHS_type, coding_status, cumulative_support TIEScore kept. CAGE cluster identifiers come FANTOM ID mapping table, see add_fantom_cat_tables(). StringTie, Bambu, FLAIR, IsoQuant SQANTI3 GTF files long-read assembled transcriptomes: reference_id/cmp_ref, ref_gene_id ref_gene_name populate source identifiers gene names; novel transcripts without biotype get transcript_type = NA add_sqanti_classification() assigns SQANTI3 structural categories. Genes features gene-like type parents transcripts; transcripts features transcript-like type parents exons. title: Structural and Coding Features of Transcripts — transcript_features
text: Computes, every assayed transcript, features go beyond biotype label, exon CDS coordinates annotation: Ends: tss_pos, tes_pos (genomic positions transcription start end), tss_group tes_group (integer labels alternative promoters / 3' ends within gene; starts ends closer end_window bp share group). ORF: has_cds, cds_complete (FALSE annotation flags incomplete CDS cds_start_NF/cds_end_NF), orf_length (nt), utr5_length, utr3_length. NMD rule: stop_to_last_junction, distance transcript coordinates stop codon last exon-exon junction, nmd_predicted (TRUE distance exceeds nmd_rule nt, classical 50-55 nt rule). ORF transcript comes first applicable source (orf_source): "annotation": complete annotated CDS. stop codon added annotation excludes (GENCODE ) ORF re-read annotated start codon first -frame stop, CDS match sequence corrected (annotation_cds_agrees = FALSE). Transcripts tagged seleno, ribosomal_slippage non_ATG_start keep annotated CDS. "projected": start codon gene's canonical isoform lies exon transcript reads ATG ; translation proceeds position first -frame stop (ORFanage approach). rescues novel isoforms without CDS. "annotation_partial": annotated CDS flagged incomplete (cds_start_NF / cds_end_NF) whose start projected; annotated span kept, 3' end known NMD rule still applies (GENCODE annotates many NMD transcripts way).
